headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped a two-week winning streak as surging crude oil prices weighed on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Crude oil prices surged to $117 per barrel, dragging Indian shares to weekly losses
Investors engaged in profit booking after the market enjoyed a two-week gaining streak
Global cues and concerns over feedstock costs in the ethanol sector impacted sentiment
Persistent selling pressure throughout the week led to a 2% decline in major indices
whatHappening: Nifty 50 finished the last session at the 22,600 level while the Sensex dropped 125 points
IDFC First Bank reported a multifold jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,045 crore with NII up 21%
Adani Enterprises emerged as the top loser during the weekly market wrap
IT stocks witnessed buying interest on the last trading day, helping indices rebound from intraday lows
summary: In the last trading session, Indian indices closed lower with the Nifty at 22,600, marking a 2% weekly decline driven by crude oil hitting $117 per barrel. While IDFC First Bank reported strong Q2 earnings, Adani Enterprises led the weekly losers amid broader market volatility. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday, 27 October.
